entry.title: What Google did with a brand new site in its first 24 hours
entry.summary:
We put a new site online with no backlinks, no audience and no history. Sixteen pages, a sitemap, and a Google Search Console property connected the same afternoon. Then we recorded what Google said about every page, the first morning and the next. That record is the only reason this article exists. Search Console answers the question for today and keeps nothing, so the day-one state of a site is normally gone by day two. Ours is not. On the first afternoon, Google had not heard of any of it. Every page came back as unknown. By the next morning's check, thirteen of the sixteen were indexed.
What Google reported First afternoon Next morning
Indexed 0 13
Seen but not indexed yet 0 1
Not heard of at all 16 2
That is the part worth sitting with if you have ever been sold an index…

entry.summary: I'm halfway through Gen AI Academy's APAC Edition, and honestly? It's been the kind of experience that makes you realize how much you don't know — and how excited you should be about that. The Setup What's Actually Happening HackTronix 2.0 (Track A) — We're building a 3D LiDAR-based system to assess shelter damage after natural disasters. The intersection of computer vision, hardware, and real-world impact is chef's kiss. It's one thing to learn about point clouds in a textbook. It's another to actually process them for something that could help people. EVA (Early Vulnerability Assessment for Women's Aspirations) — An AI platform we're developing during the hackathon. This one's personal because it's about creating tools that actually matter for underrepresented groups. The Real Learning AI isn't just software — Building something that works in the real world means understanding hardware constraints, edge cases, and the messy reality of actual deployment What's Next If you're on the fence about applying to something like this — whether it's Gen AI Academy or any hackathon/bootcamp — just do it. The experience of building alongside people who are just as confused and excited as you is worth way more than the certificate. To My Fellow Builders If you're also at Gen AI Academy APAC or any similar program: what's your highlight so far? Drop a comment — I'd love to hear what everyone's working on.
